rv.q: Andrew Panton’s production compensates with wit and verve, the cast launching into Claire McKenzie’s magpie score with gusto as it switches from rock to gospel to bhangra.
But the play itself seems uneasily poised between peddling a transgressive hope and deploying a Swiftian scepticism.
This is a bonkers romp through the most famous love story of all time via some of the biggest pop songs of all time.
